visual_action: A screenshot of two tweets is superimposed over footage of Donald Trump speaking at a rally. The first tweet is from 'The White House' and includes a short video of people walking along a border fence. The second tweet is a reply from musician Sabrina Carpenter condemning the first one. Below Trump, a podium sign reads 'TRUMP VANCE MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN 2024'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in the background footage, speaking at a rally.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: A screenshot of a tweet from the official '@WhiteHouse' account is shown, forming the basis of the narrative.

cast.name: Sabrina Carpenter
cast.evidence: A screenshot of her reply tweet is shown, where she condemns the White House's video. Her music is also used.

cast.name: JD Vance
cast.evidence: His name appears on the 'TRUMP VANCE' podium sign.

on_screen_text.text:
The White House @WhiteHouse · 15h
Have you ever tried this one?
Bye bye 👋

Sabrina Carpenter @SabrinaAnnLynn
this video is evil and disgusting. Do not ever involve me or my music to benefit your inhumane agenda.

TRUMP VANCE
MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN
2024

spoken_summary: A female voice says, "Have you ever tried this one?" which mirrors the text in the on-screen tweet from The White House.
audio_music: The entire video features the upbeat pop song 'Juno' by Sabrina Carpenter. A female voice speaks a single line over the music near the start. The cheerful music creates a sharp contrast with the artist's on-screen condemnation of its use in a political context.
editing_pacing: The video is a static composition, showing screenshots layered over a still or very slowly moving background clip of Donald Trump.
central_claim: The post leverages Sabrina Carpenter's angry condemnation of the White House using her music for a border-related video to imply that Donald Trump's agenda is similarly 'evil, disgusting, and inhumane'.
intended_effect: To associate Donald Trump with an 'inhumane' agenda that is being rejected by a popular cultural figure, aiming to turn her fans against him.
uncertainty_flags: The post's messaging is complex, as it originates from the @democrats account but uses a celebrity's criticism of the (presumably Democratic) White House to attack Donald Trump.
